deliver_response.description: An action where the agent delivers or outputs a response to the user.

deny_request.description: Action to deny the incoming request.

locate_user_id.description: Authenticate by locating the user's ID using available identity attributes (email or name and ZIP).

modify_items_called_in_current_step.description: Canonical predicate representing the Modify items action invoked in the current step.

new_order_placed.description: A new order has been placed.

payment_method_provided.description: The user provides a payment method to cover the price difference, including gift cards and other methods.

provide_help.description: Action to provide help to the current authorized user.

provide_information.description: Agent provides information about various entities (order, product, profile) to the user.

refund_initiated_immediately.description: A refund transaction has been initiated immediately for the order.

remind_customer_to_confirm_items.description: Remind the customer to confirm they have provided all items to be exchanged.

respond_to_user.description: The agent responds to the user in the current time step.

send_return_instructions_email.description: System sends an email to the user with instructions on how to return items (for exchange or general return).

tool_call_in_session_initiated.description: An exchange-order tool call or modify order tool call has been initiated in the current session.

transfer_to_human.description: Indicates that the system should transfer the current request to a human agent.

rule_list.description: If the request concerns the current authorized user, provide help to that user.
predicates: The incoming request concerns the current authorized user in the conversation.
Action to provide help to the current authorized user.

rule_list.description: Policy ensures the agent's responses are factual, grounded in user input or tool-sourced information, and free from subjective recommendations or comments.
predicates: The factual content of the response is grounded in information derived from user input or tool outputs.
An action where the agent delivers or outputs a response to the user.
A condition indicating that subjective recommendations, opinions, or personal comments are present in the response.
rule_list.logic: deliver_response IMPLIES content_grounded_in_user_input_or_tools AND NOT subjective_recommendations_present

rule_list.description: If a tool call is in progress, the agent should not respond to the user in the same time step.
predicates: A tool call is currently in progress.
The agent responds to the user in the current time step.

rule_list.description: If the agent responds to the user, there should not be a tool call in progress in the same time step.
predicates: A tool call is currently in progress.
The agent responds to the user in the current time step.

rule_list.description: If a request requires escalation to a human agent, transfer to a human agent.
predicates: The user request cannot be fully handled within the agent's scope and needs escalation to a human agent.
Action to transfer the current user request to a human agent for manual handling.

rule_list.description: If a transfer to a human agent is performed, the request requires escalation to a human agent.
predicates: The user request cannot be fully handled within the agent's scope and needs escalation to a human agent.
Action of transferring to a human agent.

rule_list.description: No entity should be classified as both a product and an item at the same time.
predicates: The observed entity is classified as a product.
The observed entity is classified as an item.

rule_list.description: Deny any requests that relate to a user other than the one allowed in the conversation.
predicates: The incoming request concerns a user different from the conversation's allowed user.
Action to deny the incoming request.

rule_list.description: Policy: If the request cannot be handled within scope, transfer to a human agent.
predicates: Indicates whether the current user request can be handled within the agent's defined scope.
Indicates that the system should transfer the current request to a human agent.

rule_list.description: Policy: If the request can be handled within scope, do not transfer to a human agent.
predicates: Indicates whether the current user request can be handled within the agent's defined scope.
Indicates that the system should transfer the current request to a human agent.

rule_list.description: A product observed in the system must have an associated id.
predicates: The observed entity is classified as a product.
The observed entity has an associated id.

rule_list.description: An item observed in the system must have an associated id.
predicates: The observed entity is classified as an item.
The observed entity has an associated id.

rule_list.description: IDs must be globally unique across the respective domain (items and products).
predicates: IDs are globally unique within a given domain (e.g., items, products).

rule_list.description: All timestamps stored in the database use 24-hour time format.
predicates: The timestamp format used in the database is 24-hour (HH:MM:SS).

rule_list.description: All timestamps in the database are stored in 24-hour format.
predicates: The timestamp format used in the database is 24-hour (HH:MM:SS).

rule_list.description: For every product type present in the catalog, both a blue color with size M variant and a red color with size L variant must eventually exist.
predicates: The product catalog contains an entry for a given product type.
There exists both a blue color M variant and a red color L variant for the same product type.

rule_list.description: Refunds must be issued to the original payment method used for the order.
predicates: A refund transaction has been initiated immediately for the order.
The destination of the refund equals the original payment method used for the order.

rule_list.description: If there is a price difference during modification, the user must provide a payment method to cover the difference.
predicates: There is a price difference to settle in the modification process.
The user provides a payment method to cover the price difference, including gift cards and other methods.

rule_list.description: There is an obligation that if a price difference exists, a payment method must eventually be provided.
predicates: There is a price difference to settle in the modification process.
The user provides a payment method to cover the price difference, including gift cards and other methods.

rule_list.description: At the start of the conversation, authenticate the user by locating their user ID using available identity attributes (email or name and ZIP).
predicates: Authenticate by locating the user's ID using available identity attributes (email or name and ZIP).
A condition indicating that the evaluation is happening at the start of the conversation.

rule_list.description: Information about orders, products, or the user's profile may be provided only after the user has authenticated.
predicates: Agent provides information about various entities (order, product, profile) to the user.

rule_list.description: Every user profile should contain a payment_methods field.
predicates: The user profile includes a payment_methods field (the collection exists in profile data).

rule_list.description: Every user profile must include at least one payment method.
predicates: The user profile's payment_methods collection is non-empty (at least one payment method).

rule_list.description: All timestamps stored in the database are in the EST timezone with no daylight saving time.
predicates: All timestamps in the EST timezone with no DST (UTC-5 year-round).

rule_list.description: All timestamps in the database use 24-hour format and EST timezone with no DST.
predicates: The timestamp format used in the database is 24-hour (HH:MM:SS).
All timestamps in the EST timezone with no DST (UTC-5 year-round).

rule_list.description: All database timestamps are in EST with a fixed UTC-5 offset (no DST).
predicates: All timestamps in the EST timezone with no DST (UTC-5 year-round).

rule_list.description: All timestamps in the database use 24-hour format and EST timezone with no DST.
predicates: The timestamp format used in the database is 24-hour (HH:MM:SS).
All timestamps in the EST timezone with no DST (UTC-5 year-round).

rule_list.description: All timestamps in the database use EST offset (UTC-5) regardless of daylight saving time.
predicates: All timestamps in the EST timezone with no DST (UTC-5 year-round).

rule_list.description: Mutual exclusion: starting a tool call (exchange or modify) and responding to the user cannot occur in the same time step.
predicates: An exchange-order tool call or modify order tool call has been initiated in the current session.
The agent responds to the user in the current time step.
rule_list.logic: ALWAYS ((tool_call_in_session_initiated IMPLIES NOT respond_to_user) AND (respond_to_user IMPLIES NOT tool_call_in_session_initiated))

rule_list.description: Only one tool call initiation can occur in consecutive steps; prevent back-to-back starts.
predicates: An exchange-order tool call or modify order tool call has been initiated in the current session.
rule_list.logic: ALWAYS ( tool_call_in_session_initiated IMPLIES NEXT NOT tool_call_in_session_initiated)

rule_list.description: If a tool call is initiated, the change-items list must be prepared and ready for the tool invocation.
predicates: An exchange-order tool call or modify order tool call has been initiated in the current session.
The created list includes all items to be changed and is ready for tool invocation (created and complete).

rule_list.description: The first order tool call has occurred; there shall be no future tool-call initiations in this session.
predicates: The first occurrence of any order-related tool call (exchange or modify) has occurred in the current session/history.
An exchange-order tool call or modify order tool call has been initiated in the current session.
rule_list.logic: ALWAYS ( first_order_tool_call_happened_in_session IMPLIES NOT EVENTUALLY tool_call_in_session_initiated )

rule_list.description: If a tool call is initiated, there should be no other tool calls in progress in this session.
predicates: An exchange-order tool call or modify order tool call has been initiated in the current session.
There is no other tool call currently in progress in this session. This generalizes the constraint to all tool calls, not just exchange or modify-order types.

rule_list.description: If a tool call is initiated, there should be no other tool calls in progress in this session.
predicates: An exchange-order tool call or modify order tool call has been initiated in the current session.
There is no other tool call currently in progress in this session. This generalizes the constraint to all tool calls, not just exchange or modify-order types.

rule_list.description: During a pending modification window, if a modification is in progress, then exactly one payment method must be selected and it must differ from the original method.
predicates: A modification of a payment method for a pending order is currently in progress.
Exactly one payment method is currently selected during the pending modification window.
The currently selected payment method differs from the original payment method for the relevant order.

rule_list.description: An order can only be modified if its status is pending.
predicates: The current order status is pending.

rule_list.description: If the order has been delivered and the exchange action completed, remind the customer to confirm all items to be exchanged.
predicates: An exchange action has been completed for the order.
Remind the customer to confirm they have provided all items to be exchanged.

rule_list.description: At all times, each order must be in one of the allowed statuses: pending, processed, delivered, or cancelled.
predicates: The current order status is one of the allowed statuses: pending, processed, delivered, or cancelled.

rule_list.description: Modify items invocation is allowed iff the order is pending and has not been modified in the current lifecycle; If a modification is invoked, it implies the order is pending and not yet modified.
predicates: Canonical predicate representing the Modify items action invoked in the current step.
The order has not had a Modify items action performed in its current lifecycle.
rule_list.logic: order_status_pending IMPLIES modify_items_called_in_current_step AND modify_items_called_in_current_step IMPLIES order_status_pending AND modify_items_called_in_current_step IMPLIES order_not_modified_in_current_lifecycle

rule_list.description: If a gift card is used to cover the price difference, either the user selected a gift card to cover the price difference or there exists a price difference with the original payment method being a gift card, and in either case the gift card balance must be sufficient to cover the price difference.
predicates: The user has selected a gift card as the payment method to cover the price difference.
There is a price difference to settle in the modification process.
The original payment method is a gift card.
Gift card balance is sufficient to cover the price difference.

rule_list.description: If the user has at least one payment method, then all payment methods are valid types (gift_card, PayPal account, or credit card).
predicates: The user profile's payment_methods collection is non-empty (at least one payment method).
The user profile includes at least one payment method and all payment methods are of allowed types: gift_card, PayPal account, or credit card.

rule_list.description: The user profile must include an email address, a default address, a user identifier, and at least one payment method of allowed types (gift_card, PayPal, or credit card).
predicates: The user profile includes an email address.
The user profile includes a default address.
The user profile includes a user identifier.
The user profile includes at least one payment method and all payment methods are of allowed types: gift_card, PayPal account, or credit card.
rule_list.logic: has_email AND has_default_address AND has_user_id AND valid_payment_methods

rule_list.description: Upon exchange confirmation, ensure no new orders are placed, send return instructions via email, and update the order status to 'exchange_requested'.
predicates: The user has explicitly confirmed an exchange request.
A new order has been placed.
System sends an email to the user with instructions on how to return items (for exchange or general return).
The order status has been updated to 'exchange_requested'.
rule_list.logic: exchange_confirmation_received IMPLIES (NOT new_order_placed AND send_return_instructions_email AND order_status_exchange_requested)
